title: Midnight snack
blurb: Alex walks into a pitch-dark kitchen at 23:40. A plain reflex rule turns the light on before any model is asked.

steps.text: 23:40 on a Tuesday. Sam is away for work and Alex has been reading by phone light in the dark living room.
Alex gets up for a snack.
Dark room + a person + night: the reflex rule turned the light on in milliseconds. No model was asked.
For comparison, the 2B scene decider needs 0.8 s on this scene and was only 63% sure of 'turn on lights'.
Reflexes stay in code. The models are saved for words and activity that need understanding.
